item.title: US students design quadrotor biplane for lifesaving missions
item.description: The quadrotor biplane will be used for emergency tasks, including delivering medical supplies, and locating trapped individuals.

item.title: Lockheed SPY-7 radar passes live target tracking test for Japan ships
item.description: The U.S. Missile Defense Agency has completed the first live-target tracking test of the SPY-7 radar, clearing a key hurdle for Japan's ASEV program.

item.title: New method checks heat exchanger strength for safer nuclear reactors
item.description: A new method helps verify diffusion weld strength, boosting confidence in compact heat exchangers for next-gen nuclear reactors.

item.title: Europe's largest vanadium flow battery stores 8 MWh for over 15 hours
item.description: Spain has just completed testing Europe's biggest vanadium battery with more than 15 hours of energy storage.

item.title: 36 years later, sunken Soviet nuclear sub still leaks radiation
item.description: Researchers detected a visible plume of radioactive material escaping from a ventilation pipe near the reactor compartment.

item.title: Little chance US could convince China on any nuclear arms control deals
item.description: A report claimed that the three nuclear superpowers (US, Russia and China) are not taking active steps towards a meaningful negotiation. The new deal becomes crucial following the the expiry of New Start arms treaty in February.

item.title: Czech nuclear plant gets turbine diagnostics system upgrade
item.description: A new health monitoring system installed at Temelin nuclear power plant in the Czech Republic measures turbine rotation delays down to a billionth of a second.

item.title: China conducting oceanographic surveys for undersea surveillance
item.description: China is mapping vast stretches of the ocean floor, gathering data that experts say could give its submarines a major strategic advantage.

item.title: Military Archives - Interesting Engineering
item.description: Stay informed about the latest advancements in military technology, defense strategies, and global conflicts. Explore the intersection of technology and the military world.

item.title: Singlet fission breaks 'ceiling' of solar cells for 130% quantum yield
item.description: Researchers from Kyushu and JGU Mainz have shattered the "physical ceiling" of solar power, achieving a 130% quantum yield.

item.title: China tests underwater missile engine in 200-meter deep-sea simulation
item.description: Chinese engineers have successfully ignited a solid rocket engine at a simulated depth of 200 meters (656 feet).

item.title: US: 10-foot hidden container missile launcher aces test with HELLFIRE
item.description: Lockheed Martin’s GRIZZLY container launcher completes live-fire trials, showcasing a fast, low-signature missile system for modern warfare.

item.title: Microsoft, NVIDIA join forces to accelerate nuclear reactor deployment with new digital tools
item.description: A new partnership between tech giants aims to replace manual regulatory reviews with AI-driven document drafting and unified data.

item.title: World's first antimatter truck transport could solve Big Bang mystery
item.description: CERN has delivered antimatter by truck for the first time in a bid to open the door for high-precision physics experiments across Europe.

item.title: MIT team decodes 'cracks' that cause short circuits in batteries
item.description: New MIT tudy reveals dendrites grow faster under low stress, shifting focus to chemical causes of solid-state battery failure.
